info.name: Product Order API
info.description:
End-to-end walk through every endpoint, in order. Run the folders top to bottom (Collection Runner, or `npm run e2e:postman`).

Before running: start the API, run `npm run seed` (creates the admin), and use the "Local" environment.
Auth routes are rate limited to 5 requests per 15 minutes per IP and per route. One run makes 3 login and 3 register calls,
so it fits, but it cannot be run twice in 15 minutes: restart the API between runs (that resets the counters), or start it with AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=100.
The run stops at the first request that later requests depend on if it fails, and stops with an explanation on a 429.
The product requests upload e2e/sample.png: if Postman asks for the file, pick it from the e2e folder.

exec: pm.test("429 Too Many Requests: the auth rate limit (5 per 15 minutes per IP) is used up. Restart the API, or start it with AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=100, then run again", function () { throw new Error("rate limited"); });
// a fresh run id makes emails and product names unique; leftovers from an earlier run are cleared

pm.test("has X-Request-Id and helmet headers", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Request-Id")).to.be.ok; pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Content-Type-Options")).to.eql("nosniff"); });

pm.test("customer, tokens, no password in the response", function () { pm.expect(j.data.user.role).to.eql("customer"); pm.expect(j.data.token).to.be.ok; pm.expect(j.data.refreshToken).to.be.ok; pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/passwordHash|"password"/); });
pm.test("price in rupees, 1 image", function () { pm.expect(j.data.price).to.eql(499.99); pm.expect(j.data.images.length).to.eql(1); });

request.description: Pick e2e/sample.png for the images field if Postman asks for the file.

pm.test("stock and rating fields", function () { pm.expect(j.data.stock).to.eql(6); pm.expect(j.data.averageRating).to.eql(0); });

request.description: The product must keep 1 to 5 images.

item.name: Replay the same key and body (same order)

exec: pm.test("same order id, replay header", function () { pm.expect(j.data.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("orderId")); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Idempotency-Replayed")).to.eql("true"); });

item.name: Not enough stock (409 lists the item)

exec: pm.test("INSUFFICIENT_STOCK with requested and available", function () { pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("INSUFFICIENT_STOCK"); pm.expect(j.error.details[0].requested).to.eql(100); pm.expect(j.error.details[0].available).to.eql(4); });
pm.test("lists what the customer may do", function () { pm.expect(j.error.details[0].allowedTransitions[0].to).to.eql("Cancelled"); });
pm.test("name comes from the account", function () { pm.expect(j.data.reviewerName).to.eql("Asha Patel"); });

pm.test("IST report with totals and all four statuses", function () { pm.expect(j.data.range.timezone).to.eql("Asia/Kolkata"); pm.expect(j.data.orderCount).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(j.data.ordersByStatus).to.have.keys(["Pending","Shipped","Delivered","Cancelled"]); pm.expect(j.data.revenuePerDay.length).to.eql(1); });
